overview_description.description: Inconvo develops conversational research software that connects brands with digital audiences for real-time insight gathering. Its platform uses automated chat infrastructure, including chatbots on messenger channels and online touchpoints, to facilitate structured two-way conversations with consumers. The technology is designed to transform passive online audiences into engaged communities that can answer targeted research questions. InConversation Media focuses on supporting brands and research organizations that need scalable ways to validate opinions, test concepts, and measure sentiment. The platform is integrated into broader data and analytics workflows to capture, structure, and stream audience feedback. As part of YouGov, InConversation Media operates as a specialized unit that underpins digital panels and interactive research experiences used in commercial market research programs.
